_meta.purpose: Version manifest for every audit-knowledge pack. Written into each run's log (spec sec 16.2, which requires a logged mapping_version) so a finding can be traced back to the exact rule set that produced it.
_meta.note: Bump a pack's own _meta.version when you change it, then update the row here. pack_versions() reads the packs directly, so this file is the human-readable index, not the source of truth.
